title_en: Fall 2026 Graduate New Student Orientation (September 2026 Entrants)
summary: New graduate students entering in Fall 2026 (admitted September 2026) are encouraged to attend the new student orientation. It will be held on Wednesday, 26 August 2026, from 2:00 p.m. in Room 102, Building 301, Seoul National University. The orientation will cover graduate courses, theses, graduation, the student center and other academic matters.

translation:
Notice of the Fall 2026 Graduate New Student Orientation (September 2026 Entrants)

At this new student orientation (OT), we will provide general guidance on academic matters, including graduate courses, theses, graduation and the student center.

We encourage all new graduate students to attend.

● Date and time: Wednesday, 26 August 2026, from 2:00 p.m.

● Venue: Room 102, Building 301, Seoul National University

● Who should attend: New graduate students for Fall 2026 (students admitted in September 2026)

● Inquiries: Department administrative office (학부행정실, Room 319, Building 301). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachment (1 file): 2026-2학기_대학원_신입생_OT.png (1 MB). [The content of this image was not read.]
